name: compareempire
description: CompareEmpire — a monorepo of price-comparison sites (CameraCompare, DexCompare) plus the CompareEmpire hub. (RiftCompare is archived under archived/.)

scripts.install:all: for d in apps/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm install); done
scripts.seed:cameracompare: cd apps/cameracompare && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:dexcompare: cd apps/dexcompare && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
